rules.penalty: Administrative fines of $1,000 to $10,000 per violation, actual damages or three times one month's rent, punitive damages, attorneys' fees and costs, and injunctive relief.
rules.title: Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance (criminal history)
rules.requirement: Landlords in Berkeley may not ask about or use criminal history or criminal background checks in ads, applications, tenant selection, or decisions. If a landlord acts based on criminal history where allowed, they must give written notice and a chance to respond.
rules.requirement_es: Los arrendadores en Berkeley no pueden preguntar ni usar antecedentes penales ni verificaciones de antecedentes penales en anuncios, solicitudes, selección de inquilinos o decisiones. Si un arrendador actúa por antecedentes penales cuando está permitido, debe dar aviso por escrito y la oportunidad de responder.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to rental housing providers in Berkeley for current and prospective tenants. Exemptions (see ordinance for details): lifetime sex offenders; limited exemptions for public housing/Section 8; owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where an owner of record lives in one unit; units rented under an agreement letting owners move back (BMC 13.76.130 A.9); existing tenants subletting or adding/replacing roommates.
rules.quote: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
